title: Skyline / Run
blurb: Six sections from The Start to Final Sprint, with a red wall-run and a red finish gate.

verification.notes: Stands on the start roof. Harness sprint frames show no movement: the game clears held keys on pointerlockchange, and the harness presses W+Shift before the lock lands (no key repeat in Playwright). Pressing keys 300 ms after start: walk 25 km/h, sprint 40 km/h. Not a gameplay bug.
